title: Catching Greenwashing from Space
subtitle: Verifying Palm Oil Zero-Deforestation Claims Using Satellite Data and Natural Language Processing
author: Ritik Ghoghari
degree: M.Sc. Data Science, AI & Digital Business
institution: GISMA University of Applied Sciences, Berlin

nlp_models.name: climatebert/environmental-claims
nlp_models.description: Filters genuine zero-deforestation commitments from boilerplate corporate disclosures.

nlp_models.name: climatebert/distilroberta-base-climate-specificity
nlp_models.description: Measures whether promises contain auditable metrics, targets, and dates versus vague promises.

nlp_models.name: ProsusAI/finbert
nlp_models.description: Scores corporate promotional cheerfulness; directly feeds the composite mismatch formula (weight 0.15).

nlp_models.name: climatebert/distilroberta-base-climate-sentiment
nlp_models.description: Comparative climate signal showing 99.8% of palm oil claims framed as commercial opportunities.

nlp_models.name: nbroad/ESG-BERT
nlp_models.description: Categorizes corporate commitments into official SASB ESG topics (Land Use, Emissions, Labor).

satellite_systems.name: Hansen Global Forest Change v1.13
satellite_systems.result: 890,168 ha post-2020 loss detected across 290 mills
satellite_systems.description: Quantifies annual canopy loss >5m height within 10 km radial mill catchments post-EUDR cutoff.

satellite_systems.name: Descals Global Oil Palm 10m Map
satellite_systems.result: 56.0% of post-2020 buffer clearing verified oil palm (89.8% for IOI)
satellite_systems.description: Verifies that forest clearings were converted directly to industrial oil palm plantations.

satellite_systems.name: RADD Radar Disturbance Alerts
satellite_systems.result: Active weekly clearing confirmed at 4 of top 5 highest-loss mills
satellite_systems.description: Pierces persistent tropical storm clouds and monsoon haze to verify real-time disturbance.

satellite_systems.name: NASA/IBM Prithvi-EO-2.0-300M + Linear Probe
satellite_systems.technology: Vision Transformer (ViT) with Supervised Linear Probe
satellite_systems.result: Spearman rho = 0.805, IoU = 0.765, Recall = 0.839 (+34.8% correlation gain)
satellite_systems.description: Adapts pre-trained 300M ViT embeddings via a lightweight linear probe without expensive retraining.
